outcome: Composite outcome of PTB, preeclampsia, GDM, PPROM, and postterm pregnancies
cohort: 73 single pregnant women who underwent amniocentesis for genetic purposes between 16-22 weeks of gestation
finding: Second-trimester amniotic fluid CRP levels are not significantly associated with a composite outcome of preterm birth, preeclampsia, gestational diabetes mellitus, preterm premature rupture of membranes, and postterm pregnancies.
